name: kraken
languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak

actions.name: freedom of movement
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores &reference[difficult terrain], and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be &reference[restrained apply=false]. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being &reference[grappled apply=false].

actions.name: siege monster
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .lfg28JvVAru30yJ4]]{tentacle} attacks, each of which it can replace with one use of [[/item .bwwyMBn4QwiNd4SM]]{Fling}.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature &reference[grappled apply=false] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is &reference[blinded] and &reference[restrained], it has &reference[total cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and it takes [[/damage average activity=VTJvMyMKrJPYYlkL]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save activity=taaOeSxgB6hWSvep]] saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall &reference[prone] in a space within 10 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting &reference[prone].

actions.name: tentacle
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target is &reference[grappled] (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is &reference[restrained]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has ten [[lookup @item.name lowercase]]{monster}s, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: fling
actions.desc: One Large or smaller object held or creature &reference[grappled apply=false] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]] is thrown up to [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=sJvtsq6W2RMb5ekp]] in a random direction and knocked &reference[prone]. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes [[/damage average activity=sJvtsq6W2RMb5ekp]] damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a [[/save activity=POuIOxIPF4zYDksd]] saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked &reference[prone].

actions.name: lightning storm
actions.desc: The kraken magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target the kraken can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=TwlWJt0B9uRQsZta]] of it. A target must make a [[/save activity=TwlWJt0B9uRQsZta]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=TwlWJt0B9uRQsZta]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: tentacle attack or fling
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .lfg28JvVAru30yJ4]]{tentacle} attack or uses its [[/item .bwwyMBn4QwiNd4SM]]{Fling}.

actions.name: ink cloud
actions.desc: While underwater, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} expels an ink cloud in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=hiENaqOgCBRB5rlo]]. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is &reference[heavily obscured] to creatures other than the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Each creature other than the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that ends its turn there must succeed on a [[/save activity=qfZqaaSpH5AIxvFM]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=qfZqaaSpH5AIxvFM]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.
